column1: # P2-098 owner probe of owner_probe.sh (2026-11-06, base M3JDK master 2d8273c6ad55): the held M3FilteredCursorReadinessSelfTest (donor blob 97fa2d5b3158, package line mapped) with check/same/expect recording instead of throwing, per mode, on the module owners M3FilteredViews.filterEntries (read-only), M3MutableFilteredViews.filterEntries (mutable), M3TreeMap/M3TreeSet. Rows = mode, occurrences, failing check (label, expected, actual). Owner behaviour the test expects and master lacks: (1) filtered cursors check the owner revision: an exhausted hasNext, a prepared next and a mutable remove after an owner put/clear/slot reuse throw ConcurrentModificationException (read-only and mutable); (2) re-entrant mutation from a predicate before accepting or following a slot, from a bounded comparator (nextSlot) and before the first slot (epoch captured at construction) is detected (ConcurrentModificationException) instead of returning or NoSuchElementException; (3) the mutable values view evaluates the predicate once per entry (master: twice for some entries, e.g. [null, null, -4, -3, -3, ...]) and a nonstructural replacement keeps the prepared selection (1 call, master 2); (4) M3TreeMap.verifyInvariants throws ordering after a bounded comparator that clears the owner through the mutable view (uncaught, mode aborts). The as-is test stops at the first: exhausted cursor checks revision. HOLD_OWNER_EDIT: owners M3FilteredViews, M3MutableFilteredViews (cursor revision and callback discipline) and M3TreeMap (re-entrant comparator mutation), owner review; no owner edited here.
